request: Explain this statement: "The problem of testing whether a given polynomial over a polynomial field is a permutation polynomial can be solved in finite time ."
answer_text: For a polynomial \(f\) over a finite field \(\mathbb F_q\), being a permutation polynomial means the map \(x \mapsto f(x)\) is a bijection on the \(q\) elements of \(\mathbb F_q\). Thus the decision problem is decidable and terminates, though this brute-force method may be inefficient.
